sources.label: A collection of unofficial Android patches built with the Morphe framework
sources.author: Binarymend
patch_list: Disable Telemetry
Disables AppStartTracker and other telemetry points.
Remove Ads
Disables all ad feature toggles globally.

sources.label: bufferk
sources.author: bufferk
patch_list: Disable analytics
Suppresses Truecaller's CleverTap behavioural event tracking to prevent user-activity telemetry.
Enable premium features
Unlocks all client-side premium features by bypassing the feature-availability gate.
Hide 'Get Premium' banners
Dismisses premium upgrade prompts and paywall screens automatically.
Hide ads
Removes ads from the after-call screen and caller-ID overlay.
Hide premium upgrade prompts
Removes 'Get Premium' and 'Switch to Premium' buttons from the nav bar, settings, and profile.
Mock premium
Always shows the premium/gold badge and unlocks premium UI features.
Remove Premium UI
Removes the Premium tab from the bottom navigation bar and the Premium row in the profile section.

sources.label: Custom Morphe patches by heval99
sources.author: Heval
patch_list: Disable ads
Removes all ads.
Disable auto-launch
Stops Truecaller from opening itself in the background.
Disable contact upload
Stops uploading your contacts. Chat can no longer find which contacts use it.
Disable nags
Disables default dialer, permission and survey prompts.
Disable telemetry
Disables analytics, tracking and crash reporting.
Disable update prompts
Disables the update prompts.
Enable Premium
Unlocks premium features. Server features like Who viewed me stay locked.
Fix T9 contact search
Fixes T9 search not finding new contacts.
GmsCore support
Makes Google sign-in and Google services work. Requires MicroG RE. Needed for Google Drive backup.
Hide after-call screen for contacts
Hides the after-call screen for saved contacts.
Hide Assistant tab
Turns off Call Assistant and hides its tab.
Hide Blocking tab
Hides the Blocking tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Hide business media
Hides brand images, videos and campaign cards on business contacts.
Hide call log filters
Hides the filter bar above the call log.
Hide family button
Turns off Family Protection and hides its button.
Hide frequently called contacts
Hides the row of frequently called contacts above the call log.
Hide important senders
Hides the Important senders section in the Messages tab.
Hide Messages tab
Hides the Messages tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Hide Premium tab
Hides the Premium tab and the Premium entry in settings.
Hide promotions
Hides promo banners, referral offers and Who viewed me promos.
Hide Scam feed
Turns off the Scam feed, its tab and its notifications.
Hide Wear OS settings
Hides the Wear OS entry in settings.
Restore classic call log
Experimental: restores the classic call log.
Show caller number in call log
Shows the caller's number in the new call log for callers who aren't in your contacts.
Spoof signature
Fixes Google features that check the app's original signature.
Use SMS for verification codes
Reads the verification code from SMS. Verification can still fail on patched apps.

sources.label: Public Morphe patch sources — device-detection removal for Android apps. Signed
sources.author: chirag127
patch_list: Truecaller — all patches
Enables every atomic Truecaller patch above. Toggle individual patches to opt out.
Truecaller — disable contact upload (STUB)
STUB: prevent local contact book from being uploaded to Truecaller servers. Fingerprints not yet discovered.
Truecaller — disable telemetry
Disables AppStartTracker and other telemetry points.
Truecaller — disable update check
Disables the in-app update check / update nag.
Truecaller — GMS sign-in bypass
Forces SMS-based OTP verification instead of GMS SmsRetriever, fixing sign-in on re-signed APKs.
Truecaller — Google Drive sync fix (STUB)
STUB (requires MicroG-RE): restore Google Drive backup / sync on re-signed APKs. Fingerprints not yet discovered.
Truecaller — hide Assistant tab
Hides the Assistant tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Truecaller — hide Family Protection button
Hides the Family Protection button from the bottom navigation bar.
Truecaller — hide Get Premium banners
Immediately finishes the full-screen paywall activity so promotional banners never render.
Truecaller — hide Premium from settings
Hides the Premium options from the settings and user details pages.
Truecaller — hide Premium tab
Hides the Premium tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Truecaller — hide Premium upgrade UI
Kills paywall activity onCreate as a safety-net when Premium unlock is enabled.
Truecaller — hide Scams tab
Hides the Scams tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Truecaller — mock Premium badge only
Paints the Premium badge in UI without unlocking features (cosmetic-only variant of Premium unlock).
Truecaller — Premium unlock
Unlocks premium features (GOLD tier + all features + block server revocation + block expired-notification worker).
Truecaller — region unlock (STUB)
STUB: unlock region-locked features. Fingerprints not yet discovered.
Truecaller — remove ads
No-ops after-call ad update sites (Lcom/truecaller/acs/ui/baz;->Rh and Ltw1/f;->Th).
Truecaller — remove Premium UI (nav drawer + tab)
Hides bottom-nav Premium tab + PremiumNavDrawerItemView (sets GONE in onAttachedToWindow).
Truecaller — strip outbound SMS watermark (STUB)
STUB: remove the "Sent via Truecaller" trailer from outbound SMS. Fingerprints not yet discovered.
Truecaller — strip third-party analytics + ad SDKs

No-ops third-party telemetry, ad-network, and tracking SDK init calls (Clarity, CleverTap, AppsFlyer, Moloco, HMS, Freshchat, InMobi, Appnext, Vungle, Fyber, Mintegral, IronSource, HyBid, MLKit, Presence stream).

sources.author: Oyasumi
patch_list: Return an empty contact list
Make the app see an empty contact list, so nothing is shown from your address book and nothing can be matched or uploaded from it.
Stop call history sync
Stop uploading your call history to Truecaller's servers, and stop it reading the system call log to do so.
